items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer cites 'Russell' as a source for information about Basie and Page, but the interviewee (Buster Smith) does not mention Russell personally, nor does he indicate a personal relationship with him.

ctx.x: I mean, Basie had gone by then, and Page had gone... [IN JAZZ STYLES, RUSSELL SAYS BASIE WAS ON THE SESSION AND CITES BASIE]
No, Page was there when we made that "Blue Devil Blues."
